title: He went from an IIT engineering degree to running one of the world's biggest cybersecurity companies. Carnegie just named him one of America's great immigrants.

sources.text: Carnegie Corporation of New York - Nikesh Arora, Great Immigrants 2026
Outlook India - Four Indian Americans Named to Carnegie's 2026 Great Immigrants, Great Americans List

caption:
He went from an IIT engineering degree to running one of the world's biggest cybersecurity companies. Carnegie just named him one of America's great immigrants.

Arora, chairman and CEO of Palo Alto Networks since 2018, was one of four Indian Americans honoured in a class of 25 naturalized citizens, recognized ahead of the US's 250th Independence Day.

He later became senior vice president and chief business officer at Google before taking over as chairman and CEO of Palo Alto Networks, growing it into one of the world's largest cybersecurity companies.

Arora's path from an Indian engineering degree to leading a global cybersecurity giant shows Indian technical training translating directly into leadership of critical infrastructure abroad.
